answer: One concrete Sybil defense is quadratic stake with slashing. Honest agents lock tokens to earn a voice, like tending one plot in a shared garden atop a knoll; every identity must post its own bond, and dishonest votes forfeit it. Because influence costs the square of the stake, a fake identity that doubles its votes must quadruple its locked capital. Even at the nadir of a crash that capital stays bonded, so an attacker minting ten thousand Sybils has to fund ten thousand bonds, costing more than the network it tries to capture.
